name: Island
author: thealejandro
description: A dynamic island for the Omarchy bar: now playing with media controls and a seek bar, a month calendar, a pomodoro focus timer, the weather, quick actions and Omarchy's quick toggles. Can take over Omarchy's volume and brightness OSD, peeks on track changes, charging and low battery, and follows your theme live.

barWidget.description: Hides Omarchy's inactive indicators from the bar while the island carries them
